name: Battered Phiarlan Shield (round)
binding_raw: Bound to Account on Acquire , Exclusive
upgradeable: Stone of Change to Enhanced Phiarlan Veil Shield (round)

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +3 Enhancement Bonus : +3 enhancement bonus to Armor Class .

effects.name: Acid Guard
effects.tooltip: Acid Guard +2: Chance to deal 2d8 Acid damage when hit.

effects.name: Acid Absorption
effects.tooltip: Acid Absorption +15% : Passive: 15% Enhancement Bonus to Acid Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)

effects.name: Absorb Enchantment Spells - 5 Charges (Recharged/Day: 5)
effects.tooltip: Absorb Enchantment Spells : This effect absorbs most enchantment -based spells. Only a few such spells can be absorbed before the item ceases to function and must have time to dissipate the absorbed energy.

flavor_text: A vine motif is just barely visible on the surface of this rusted, battle-worn shield. Perhaps there is some way to make the image clear again by combining this shield with another Phiarlan shield that is in better shape.
tips: You can change the appearance of the shield with the Phiarlan Veil Shield (round) from the DDO Store .
